errors.evidence: This information is not present in the image itself, but in the external metadata (paper title and caption). A description of the figure should only contain information visible within the figure.

The endpoint for the blue line (3-Model Ensemble) at Cost=10 has a Reliability Score of 75. The data point is located exactly halfway between the 70 and 80 y-axis grid lines. A value of 73 is an inaccurate approximation.

The description fails to mention the explicitly plotted data points at Cost=5 for all three lines. These points are crucial for understanding the non-linear trend, especially for the 3-Model Ensemble. The approximate values are (5, 78) for the 3-Model Ensemble, (5, 79) for the 2-Model Ensemble, and (5, 65) for GPT-4.

The description omits the intersections between the lines, which are key visual events showing changes in the relative performance of the models. The GPT-4 (yellow) line intersects the other two lines near Cost=2, and the 2-Model (red) and 3-Model (blue) lines intersect near Cost=5.
